subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should editable Control UI dictation be accepted as a core Gateway/provider-backed feature now, given the new authenticated microphone-audio RPC and provider privacy boundary?
rationale: The design is better aligned than direct browser Web Speech, but accepting a browser-to-Gateway transcription method is a product and security-boundary decision that code review alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Continue after proof and port
options.body: Require a current-main port, the two concrete patch fixes, and redacted proof of microphone recording, Gateway/provider transcription, temp-file cleanup, and editable draft insertion before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the feature issue
options.body: Keep this PR and the linked feature issue open while maintainers decide the permanent Control UI dictation boundary and owner.

options.title: Close or supersede this branch
options.body: If maintainers prefer a fresh implementation or do not want core dictation now, close this PR and route future work through the linked issue or a new narrow PR.

recommendation.title: Continue after proof and port
recommendation.body: Require a current-main port, the two concrete patch fixes, and redacted proof of microphone recording, Gateway/provider transcription, temp-file cleanup, and editable draft insertion before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal from the prior server-side dictation implementation and is connected to the relevant Gateway/UI boundary.
